info.name: ORCA MED Partners — API (Participant + Admin + v1)
info.description:
Complete endpoint collection for the ORCA MED partner platform: participant mobile API, /v1 participant surfaces, and the admin backend API.

Setup:
1. Set `baseUrl` (default https://api.orca-med.local/api)
2. Participant flow: set `participantUsername` / `participantPassword` and run **Participant Auth → Login**; the script stores `accessToken` + `refreshToken`.
3. Admin flow: set `adminUsername` / `adminPassword` and run **Admin Auth → Admin Login**; the script stores `adminToken` + `adminRefreshToken`.
4. Protected folders use Bearer auth automatically: participant folders read `{{accessToken}}`, admin folders read `{{adminToken}}`.

Conventions:
- Success envelope { "success": true, "data": ... }
- Collections use the Laravel paginator shape (current_page / data / links / total)
- All monetary amounts are decimal strings (never floats)
- Errors use the unified envelope { "success": false, "message": ..., "errors": ... }

All endpoints verified against the Laravel test suite (full unit + feature run green).
